title: ci-ingress params
description: Operator-facing config keys for the ci-ingress bundle — ADR-0081's locked decision: bundle params validate against JSON Schema. Secret references are NAMES, never values.

node_url.description: Base URL of the peregrin node hosting the ci-job entity plane (`peregrin serve` with the bupha feature — /api/entities is the hypha substrate surface). Same-host deployments use loopback.

queue.description: ci-job lane policy fallback for keys with no fleet spec: "latest" keeps one pending slot per key (newest push wins), "all" is a bounded FIFO (MAX_PENDING=32). On a spec-armed plane (CiJobPlane::with_watched, fed by the node's bupha fleet configs) the fleet config overwrites this per repo.

context.description: Forge commit-status context label recorded on the ci-job indexDoc when no fleet spec resolves one (the worker's status sink posts under the resolved context).
